messages:
maria_support: Hi team — customer Acme (john_acme) is seeing a spike of 429s and very high tail latency on their Dedicated pool (acme-prod). They say traffic is steady but scale-up isn't keeping up, requests queue and error out. Root cause suspected: min_replicas bound + warm pool attach delay.

john_acme: we're getting 30-40% failed requests during morning traffic spike. dashboard shows queueing and 'preflight throttle' in logs. can someone escalate?

kyra_oncall: thanks, @maria_support. Can you paste the exact API error and the org/cluster id? Also, any recent config changes?

maria_support: cluster: dedicated-acme-prod-42, route: /v1/generate, model pinned: redwood/gpt-13b-v1 (quantized). Recent change: customer lowered autoscaler headroom target from 20% -> 10% last week (support ticket #4982).

samir_infra: pulling autoscaler + provisioning logs now. Quick question: is this min_replicas > 0 situation? If min_replicas set too low, warm pool attach can swamp the attach pipeline.

maria_support: min_replicas=1, max_replicas=12. They expect bursts up to ~350 rps. Warm pool configured: 0.

jake_engops: that min=1 + warm_pool=0 + headroom=10% seems risky for big spikes. If every scale event needs fresh instances, attach rtts hit and queues form.

samir_infra: found relevant logs at 2023-11-02T08:12:45Z (autoscaler):
```
INFO autoscaler: decision=scale_up desired=8 current=1 reason="latency_sla_violation"
WARN provisioner: warm_pool_attach_delay ms=4120 instance_type=gpu-a100 queue=5
ERROR provisioner: attach_failed id=req-0x9f attempt=1 reason="timeout waiting for GPU attach"
INFO autoscaler: backoff next_check=15s
```

kyra_oncall: that attach_delay ~4s each and attach failures explain why desired is 8 but we only get 1 for several minutes. What about noisy neighbor / thin hosts? Any OOM or host saturation logs?

samir_infra: host telemetry shows two hosts with high GPU memory fragmentation (from other tenants) at the same time window. Also a transient node-group quota bump that made scheduler pick slower instance pool.

maria_support: customer reported they recently started a large vector-reindex job in their org. Could be noisy neighbor effect. Customer said they didn't change their model traffic pattern.

jake_engops: workaround options:
- increase min_replicas to 3 temporarily (fastest user-facing fix)
- enable warm_pool (recommended) or pre-warm a small pool during known spikes
- bump headroom target back to 20% so autoscaler proactively keeps buffer

maria_support: @john_acme — can you confirm if we can bump min_replicas to 3 for next 6 hours? It will increase baseline cost but should stop request errors.

john_acme: we can approve the temporary bump if it solves outages. do it.

deploy-bot: deploy events: autoscaler-config update by jake_engops at 2023-11-02T08:20:12Z — changed min_replicas: 1 -> 3 for cluster dedicated-acme-prod-42 (temporary override, expires 2023-11-02T14:20:12Z).

samir_infra: we've also opened a ticket with infra to investigate host fragmentation and allocation policy that selected the slower instance pool. filing infra ticket INF-7742.

kyra_oncall: triage checklist:
- confirm 429s stop after min bump (monitoring)
- check attach delays go away (provisioner logs)
- validate warm_pool recommendation and schedule pre-warm for recurring spikes
- follow up with infra on noisy neighbor mitigation (migration / isolation)

maria_support: monitoring shows errors drop to <1% within 90s of the min_replicas change. Latency tail improves but still slightly above SLO at p99; looks like residual attach/backoff effects.

john_acme: thanks — things look much better on our side. please keep me posted on permanent mitigation.

jake_engops: next steps (assigned):
- samir_infra: investigate host fragmentation + instance pool selection (INF-7742)
- eng-ops: schedule warm_pool for acme-prod and recommend headroom config (RFC by EOD)
- support: follow up with customer and confirm cost tradeoffs

maria_support: closing loop here for now. Will re-open if errors return. :white_check_mark: 

kyra_oncall: adding note to incident log: root_cause=insufficient_warm_capacity + noisy_neighbor induced attach delays; mitigation=temp_min_replicas + warm_pool + infra remediation.

samir_infra: tagging this with related autoscaler bug #AUS-212 (exponential backoff layer allowed long stall when attach failures happen). I'll include repro steps in INF-7742.

maria_support: repro steps for infra ticket (from customer):
1) disable warm pool, set min_replicas=1, headroom=10%
2) generate a 300 RPS burst for 90s on /v1/generate pinned to quantized model
3) watch for queueing and 429s around scale decisions

jake_engops: copying config snippet for quick rollback if needed:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 3  # temp override
  max_replicas: 12
  headroom_pct: 20
warm_pool:
  enabled: true
  size: 2
```

maria_support: thanks everyone, marking as resolved for support. will update customer once infra ticket has a recommended long-term fix. :)
